_comment: Work that waits too long, checked every Monday by operations-watch.mjs. A queue counts the items in the listed statuses that have waited longer than olderThanHours, measured from when they were created (ageFrom 'created': nobody has picked them up) or from their last change (ageFrom 'lastChange': work in progress that stopped moving). Operations owns these limits: change one in a pull request when the service promise changes. Statuses must exist in the table's status check (production, 2026-11-12).
